about: How a span of days is said aloud: months as people name them while it is a year or less, then years (a year, a year and a half, two years, about thirty years), never a day count. Read by src/english/span-words.ts; the director passes the number of days.

daysPerMonth.citation: A month as people say a span of time: 365 days over 12, rounded to 30 for speech; it rounds a count of days to the months a speaker names, never decides anything.

daysPerYear.citation: A year as people say a span of time: 365 days; it rounds a count of days to the years a speaker names, never decides anything.

againAbout: A span of years said again after its first mention in the same point ('In the six years since I took this office ... Over those years, that has meant'): the words lead, Nov 12, a span is said once in a point, then 'those years' or nothing. Read by spanAgain in src/english/span-words.ts.
